verses.ar: صَلَاةٌ لِمُوسَى رَجُلِ ٱللهِ يَارَبُّ، مَلْجَأً كُنْتَ لَنَا فِي دَوْرٍ فَدَوْرٍ.
verses.kjv: A Prayer of Moses the man of God. Lord, thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations.
verses.web: A Prayer by Moses, the man of God. Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.

verses.ar: مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تُولَدَ ٱلْجِبَالُ، أَوْ أَبْدَأْتَ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَٱلْمَسْكُونَةَ، مُنْذُ ٱلْأَزَلِ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ أَنْتَ ٱللهُ.
verses.kjv: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou [art] God.
verses.web: Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.

verses.ar: تُرْجِعُ ٱلْإِنْسَانَ إِلَى ٱلْغُبَارِ وَتَقُولُ: «ٱرْجِعُوا يَا بَنِي آدَمَ».
verses.kjv: Thou turnest man to destruction; and sayest, Return, ye children of men.
verses.web: You turn man to destruction, saying, “Return, you children of men.”

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ فِي عَيْنَيْكَ مِثْلُ يَوْمِ أَمْسِ بَعْدَ مَا عَبَرَ، وَكَهَزِيعٍ مِنَ ٱللَّيْلِ.
verses.kjv: For a thousand years in thy sight [are but] as yesterday when it is past, and [as] a watch in the night.
verses.web: For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.

verses.ar: جَرَفْتَهُمْ. كَسِنَةٍ يَكُونُونَ. بِٱلْغَدَاةِ كَعُشْبٍ يَزُولُ.
verses.kjv: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are [as] a sleep: in the morning [they are] like grass [which] groweth up.
verses.web: You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass.

verses.ar: بِٱلْغَدَاةِ يُزْهِرُ فَيَزُولُ. عِنْدَ ٱلْمَسَاءِ يُجَزُّ فَيَيْبَسُ.
verses.kjv: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; in the evening it is cut down, and withereth.
verses.web: In the morning it sprouts and springs up. By evening, it is withered and dry.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّنَا قَدْ فَنِينَا بِسَخَطِكَ وَبِغَضَبِكَ ٱرْتَعَبْنَا.
verses.kjv: For we are consumed by thine anger, and by thy wrath are we troubled.
verses.web: For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath.

verses.ar: قَدْ جَعَلْتَ آثَامَنَا أَمَامَكَ، خَفِيَّاتِنَا فِي ضَوْءِ وَجْهِكَ.
verses.kjv: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, our secret [sins] in the light of thy countenance.
verses.web: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ كُلَّ أَيَّامِنَا قَدِ ٱنْقَضَتْ بِرِجْزِكَ. أَفْنَيْنَا سِنِينَا كَقِصَّةٍ.
verses.kjv: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: we spend our years as a tale [that is told].
verses.web: For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh.

verses.ar: أَيَّامُ سِنِينَا هِيَ سَبْعُونَ سَنَةً، وَإِنْ كَانَتْ مَعَ ٱلْقُوَّةِ فَثَمَانُونَ سَنَةً، وَأَفْخَرُهَا تَعَبٌ وَبَلِيَّةٌ، لِأَنَّهَا تُقْرَضُ سَرِيعًا فَنَطِيرُ.
verses.kjv: The days of our years [are] threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength [they be] fourscore years, yet [is] their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.
verses.web: The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for it passes quickly, and we fly away.

verses.ar: مَنْ يَعْرِفُ قُوَّةَ غَضَبَكَ؟ وَكَخَوْفِكَ سَخَطُكَ.
verses.kjv: Who knoweth the power of thine anger? even according to thy fear, [so is] thy wrath.
verses.web: Who knows the power of your anger, your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?

verses.ar: إِحْصَاءَ أَيَّامِنَا هَكَذَا عَلِّمْنَا فَنُؤْتَى قَلْبَ حِكْمَةٍ.
verses.kjv: So teach [us] to number our days, that we may apply [our] hearts unto wisdom.
verses.web: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

verses.ar: اِرْجِعْ يَارَبُّ، حَتَّى مَتَى؟ وَتَرَأَّفْ عَلَى عَبِيدِكَ.
verses.kjv: Return, O LORD, how long? and let it repent thee concerning thy servants.
verses.web: Relent, Yahweh! How long? Have compassion on your servants!

verses.ar: أَشْبِعْنَا بِٱلْغَدَاةِ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ، فَنَبْتَهِجَ وَنَفْرَحَ كُلَّ أَيَّامِنَا.
verses.kjv: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
verses.web: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

verses.ar: فَرِّحْنَا كَٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلَّتِي فِيهَا أَذْلَلْتَنَا، كَٱلسِّنِينِ ٱلَّتِي رَأَيْنَا فِيهَا شَرًّا.
verses.kjv: Make us glad according to the days [wherein] thou hast afflicted us, [and] the years [wherein] we have seen evil.
verses.web: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.

verses.kjv: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, and thy glory unto their children.
verses.web: Let your work appear to your servants, your glory to their children.

verses.ar: وَلْتَكُنْ نِعْمَةُ ٱلرَّبِّ إِلَهِنَا عَلَيْنَا، وَعَمَلَ أَيْدِينَا ثَبِّتْ عَلَيْنَا، وَعَمَلَ أَيْدِينَا ثَبِّتْهُ.
verses.kjv: And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.
verses.web: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us. Establish the work of our hands for us. Yes, establish the work of our hands.
